title: Chapter 402 The Black Dragon King Era Ends
content:
Chapter 402 The Black Dragon King Era Ends

The battle lasted for half a day and finally came to an end.

The Black Dragon King was purified.

Before he died, he left behind only a strong unwillingness and deep regret.

The remaining undead army was also wiped out, including several major commanders of the undead army.

In this way, only the undead base camp and some remnants were left. As long as they were all wiped out, the undead in the Dahuai domain would be completely eliminated.

After returning to Shanhai City, Zhao Bangde ordered Wang Shuo to be a general and responsible for recovering a county controlled by the undead.

Wang Shuo has now stood at the height of Zhao Bangde and has become the third strongest person in the Dahuai domain.

The lost land recovered this time is also considered Wang Shuo's territory by default.

In this battle, Wang Shuo's troops lost nearly half.

Zhao Bangde directly divided half of his Shanhai City army and gave it to him to command.

At the same time, he asked him to recruit soldiers from the remaining lords.

He announced to the entire army that Wang Shuo would rebuild Fenglin County and serve as the county governor.

For a time, many lords were eager to join Wang Shuo.

The first one to join was the top general Lin Dabiao.

His mayor had died in the battle. He could have inherited the position of Xiaochi Town mayor, but he felt that he did not want to be the mayor. He just wanted to be a general who charged into battle, so he took the initiative to propose to Wang Shuo that he wanted to join Wana County.

Wang Shuo also readily agreed.

In addition, the lords of the former Nanshan Association and Changping County, who learned that Wang Shuo was about to become the third county governor, joined Wang Shuo.

The new territory has unlimited opportunities. Wang Shuo was also short of manpower, so he accepted them all.

Soon, Wang Shuo gathered 150,000 troops and marched towards the lair of the undead.

Came to the ruins of Fenglin County.

The undead did not even have a decent senior general.

Unexpectedly, the supreme commander of the undead at this time was Zhao Tianze, who had not appeared for a long time.

He had already transformed into an undead at this time.

"Wang Shuo!"

Beside the altar, Zhao Tianze was full of anger.

This roar was full of endless resentment.

If it weren't for Wang Shuo, how could he have fallen into the undead, becoming a thing that was neither human nor ghost.

"Wang Shuo, I want to duel with you, do you dare to fight?"

Wang Shuo was surprised!

"Young man, don't you know how big the gap between you and me is now?"

He actually dared to speak so arrogantly.

Wang Shuo was a little speechless, but still agreed to his request.

"Okay, let the horse come over!"

Wang Shuo rode on Da Huang and walked out slowly.

Zhao Tianze also rode on the undead bone horse and rushed towards Wang Shuo.

Close!

Close!

Wang Shuo directly used a move "Flying Dragon in the Sky".

Zhao Tianze was shot down into a pile of broken bones without even saying his last words.

"Son of Destiny" Zhao Tianze fell completely.

The subsequent battle was without any suspense.

Wang Shuo thought there would be another fierce battle, but it turned out to be a one-sided massacre. Wang Shuo even thought that he could easily conquer the lost land with his own troops.

After pacifying the undead, Wang Shuo returned to Shanhai City.

In the back garden, Zhao Bangde, Zhu Dongheng and Wang Shuo sat around a stone table.

Wang Shuo told the two about the brocade bag.

Zhao Bangde smiled bitterly.

"Alas, it seems that we don't have many good days to live!"

The battle of the Great Wall of Steel seriously damaged the vitality of the Dahuai Territory.

At this moment, people's livelihood is in decline and everything needs to be rebuilt!

However, not long after, there was another military invasion that was enough to destroy the Dahuai Territory.

Zhao Bangde frowned, and for a moment, everyone didn't know what to say.
